'''Tasuku Hatanaka''' (Japanese: '''畠中 祐''' ''Tasuku Hatanaka'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|HZ}}.

==Biography==
Hatanaka was born on August 17, 1994, in {{wp|Sagamihara, Kanagawa}}, {{wp|Japan}}. He started work on the {{pkmn|animated series}} with {{aniseries|HZ}}, where he voiced [[Jacq]]. Hatanaka would gain additional roles including [[Roy's Kilowattrel]] and {{DL|Ann|Samurott|Ann's Samurott}}. He is married to fellow voice actor [[Sayaka Senbongi]].
